scope: Commitment 9 in full: chapeau (inert), Measure 9.1, Measure 9.2 (the nine items; recording what is not yet held), Measure 9.3 (the four initial-report clocks of 2, 5, 10 and 15 days from awareness of the model's involvement, 'save in exceptional circumstances'; intermediate reports at least every four weeks while unresolved; final report 60 days after resolution; the multiple-similar-incidents permission on two readings), Measure 9.4 (five-year retention on two readings of the incident's date); the Glossary's 'model', 'including' and 'resolved'; the Code's status (Objectives A and B; Recital (b)). Inert: Recitals (h) and (j), the Glossary preamble, 'near miss'. NOT encoded: Commitments 1 to 8 and 10 (including their cross-references to Commitment 9, listed in NOTES.md), the Appendices, the Code's other chapters.

forks.F1: 'Signatory' is undefined and the Chapter does not say how one becomes one: asked as a fact.
forks.F2: Recital (h): SMEs/SMCs 'may be exempted from some reporting commitments', not saying which: inert, no exemption encoded.
forks.F3: 'serious incident' is not in the Glossary (Article 3 AI Act applies, not deposited): the encoding asks Measure 9.3's harms.
forks.F4: 'without undue delay' in the chapeau: the encoding gives Measure 9.3's last day and nothing earlier.
forks.F5: Measure 9.1(2) with no direct reporting channel available: read as met.
forks.F6: Day counting: calendar days, awareness day excluded, last day included, no roll-forward; time zone unstated.
forks.F7: Clock start on the suspicion route: the provider's stated date of awareness of the model's involvement.
forks.F8: 'including' (Glossary): (self-)exfiltration of model weights and cyberattacks are read as within point (2). Contestable; nothing is computed from it beyond the seat's @desc.
forks.F9: Two or more points apply: the Code does not say which clock governs; every clock, the earliest and the latest are returned.
forks.F10: 'save in exceptional circumstances': an input; when true, no deadline is given.
forks.F11: Intermediate cadence: 28 days after the latest report; none owed once resolved on or before the day it would fall due.
forks.F12: 'resolved': the later of the dates of the corrective measures the Glossary names.
forks.F13: 'within the reporting timelines': two readings computed.
forks.F14: Retention, 'the date of the serious incident': start-date and end-date readings computed.
forks.F15: Retention from 29 February: 28 February five years on (the library's choice, not the Code's).
